conclusions: Both relativistic recipes completed all six required tasks with intended optimizer roles: LR .00425 passed 3/6; LR .0010625 passed 2/6. Both passed the separate clock audit diagnostic; neither qualified Tier 1.

Both non-saturating recipes also completed all six required task receipts (1/6 at LR .00425; 0/6 at LR .0010625), but their word-host encoder update contract failed. The other six nonrelativistic candidates remain partial.

Eight nonrelativistic candidates were cancelled after the word host exposed missing encoder updates. Their measured scalar/behavioral cells remain original-source context; unexecuted and cancelled cells remain explicit.

Both completed non-saturating word attempts recorded 20001 generator/discriminator/prior updates and zero encoder updates. The guard correctly rejected the host/loss mismatch before assigning a numerical quality verdict.

All six measured Gaussian cells failed sustained gates. Some observations transiently passed, while late CDF shape or width failed; a longer training allowance is an untested hypothesis rather than an established remedy.
The behavioral hosts retain task-owned particle separation, unused-token hold and reconstruction objectives. A pure trainer does not remove these problem definitions.

The word task declares 20001 actual updates with the retained 20000 schedule horizon; the clock diagnostic declares 24 probe updates with a 128 schedule horizon. These distinct frozen fields agree with their receipts.

The updated develop merge and repaired joint losses have no new GPU measurements in this environment. Original af75a3fe receipts cannot qualify the revised source; each repaired candidate requires its own complete frozen Tier 1 cohort.

cost.accounting: Sum each unique durable queue charge once; per-search campaign totals overlap.

five_word_joint_acquisition.exception_reason: Retained finite-vocabulary joint BiGAN question explicitly uses five learned 2D rows, one possible code per word; a MoG-width question needs its own protocol.

two_pole.exception_reason: This host optimizes explicit sample-particle coordinates directly, without a separate generator or latent sampling kernel.

unused_token_hold.exception_reason: Deterministic embedding controls are parameter clouds; there is no sampled latent prior or separate prior optimizer.

recommendations: Finish the reviewed two-sided BiGAN objective repair, then run the eight nonrelativistic recipes as complete new-source cohorts on GPU 0 and GPU 1 when CUDA is accessible.
Use the unchanged relativistic candidates as separately labeled original-source baseline readouts; preserve all failed and cancelled v1 receipts and charge their cost.

Consider a separately budgeted Gaussian duration or rate experiment only after inspecting the saved live curve; maintain CDF and sustained terminal criteria rather than lowering thresholds to obtain a pass.
